# Amazing Builders Painting & Remodeling

> Home remodeling and painting contractor based in Myerstown, PA. One crew handles kitchens, bathrooms, basements, stairs and railings, floors, painting, cabinets, drywall, windows and doors, decks and siding for homes in Lebanon, Lancaster and Dauphin County, plus whole-home rowhome renovations in Philadelphia.

- Address: 3564 S 5th Ave, Myerstown, PA 17067
- Phone: (267) 917-3986
- Email: info@amazingbuilderspa.com
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 7:00 am to 5:00 pm
- Free written estimates. Prices in our guides are typical regional ranges, not quotes.
